# Initial-logit calibration versus GRU architecture: preregistered investigation

Current K1075 and R634304faf1 were read first. Their default-init d64x2 Adam results refute a universal Delta=.02 switch; they do not identify calibration or alpha causally. Deferred J15dc9d06803c:000002 is not directly retrievable; the latest job report was read instead. Its .256 width audit is contextual evidence, not grounds to overwrite current K1075. K1003/K1019 concern optimizer-family calibration, not architecture or measured freezing.

Frozen inputs: 983 history records, 73 claims, 11579 lab candidates, archived compressed with measurement sources. q_a3b0c0 favors GRU64x1 over TF32x4 at shared SGD .001; its Markov-bias comment is a hypothesis, not measurement. q_e8a05a reports historical GRU64x1 advantage against narrow transformers in weak adaptive settings, but not an exact-model causal control.

Predictions before new measurements: (1) default-init GRU64x1 will have lower final mean CE than post-LN TF32x4 in shared plain SGD .0001/.001/.003, T256/512, across multiple allowed tables/splits; failures or reversed finite means count as counterexamples. (2) At Adam Delta .01/.0256/.064 the GRU64x1 versus TF32x4 advantage may weaken or reverse on some stronger-law tables; no alpha-only cutoff is predicted. (3) If initial calibration dominates, reducing output-head scale should lower TF step0 excess CE and substantially attenuate the low-SGD GRU margin without requiring recurrent structure. A distinct no-position intervention might change conditional learning, and must not be conflated with head scaling. (4) Equal-width GRU32/64 x1/x2 and TF32/64 x1/x4, with fixed TF FF128 for depth contrasts, will expose width/depth contingencies.

Planned measurements: CE0, test marginal entropy, logits variance, CE0-CEfinal, empirical conditional information and final CE; default-init baseline retained. Only allowed training datasets and runner controls will be used. Interface limitations will be reported instead of substituting tiny-lr results for exact step0. Means and SDs permit unpaired conservative pointwise intervals, not paired significance, seed-win probabilities or causal mechanisms. Compare original lab candidates only within set_id; replay datasets are distinct blocks. Repeated budgets/rates are not independent datasets. No new actionable claim yet.
